scope: Scoped opaque Runtime injection, Secret binding, config and mount delivery contracts plus Workspace command propagation and Serve admission validation; no Instance deployment, provider purchase, real-money mutation, or production readback

contractChanges.runtimeInjectionHandle: Adds opaque scoped handles with SECRET, CONFIG, DATA_MOUNT and SCRATCH_MOUNT kinds, delivery reference, Workspace/runtime identity, descriptor digest, target slot, execution epoch, fingerprint and expiry.
contractChanges.runtimeConfiguration: Adds typed config, Secret reference and mount bindings without raw value or secret material; RuntimeDeployCommand carries the approved WorkspaceApplicationRuntimeConfiguration.
contractChanges.resourceAndSecretBoundaries: Fabric ResourceExecutionBinding carries approved injection handles; SecretBindingCommand and SecretBindingReadback bind descriptor digest, input name, execution epoch and typed binding readback.
contractChanges.workspaceOwner: Workspace maps only identity-matching approved handles to descriptor-declared inputs and mounts; it does not mint or repair handles.
contractChanges.serveOwner: Serve rejects undeclared, duplicate, missing, foreign, stale, kind-mismatched, fingerprint-mismatched, expired, path-unsafe or access-mode-invalid delivery before accepted/ready/access state is written.
contractChanges.publicJson: Nested RuntimeInjectionHandle.Kind names are mapped explicitly; public JSON roundtrip preserves opaque facts and rejects raw value or secretMaterial properties.

defaultLocalGate.notes: The qualification low-space guard now exits explicitly instead of relying on errexit status from an arithmetic command; the test uses an isolated run-shaped temporary root.

limits: No browser-to-Workspace-to-Fabric-to-Serve deployment was run from this source checkpoint.
No Instance adoption, production private-network access, provider procurement, customer resource deletion, real-money charge, or Release publication was performed.
The contract and focused owner tests do not constitute qualified application readiness or owner-authoritative deployment readback.
